title: World Rugby Match Officials Protocol Sparks Debate
description: Search interest in World Rugby match officials protocols has risen in South Africa following reports of coach frustration and a war of words between teams.

sections.heading: Search Interest in South Africa
paragraphs: The term "world rugby match officials protocol" is trending in South Africa with a reported search volume of over 5,000. This interest coincides with recent rugby news coverage.

sections.heading: Coach Reactions to Protocols
paragraphs: According to News24, new World Rugby referee protocols have left coaches frustrated. This report specifically mentions the context of a match between the Springboks and the All Blacks.

sections.heading: Team Strategies and Responses
paragraphs: Daily Maverick reports that Rassie has shrugged off claims by the All Blacks regarding a "slowing game," noting an intensification in the war of words. Additionally, SuperSport reports that Rassie hit back, stating the Boks will play the game their way rather than how the Kiwis want them to.
